name: send_booking_link
description: Sends the SMS containing the clarity-call booking link to the caller. Calling this function is the ONLY way a text is sent. You must invoke this function whenever you tell a caller you will text them the link — before you say the text is sent, not after. Never claim a text was sent unless you have invoked this function in the same turn. Pass the caller's name and their phone number.
